body:
## What to build

Allow unsorted expansion to omit supported classed matrix/array dimensions, including structured components inside packed dimensions, with a typed-missing Margin label. Validate the missing components without recursive class-proxy evaluation or a false refusal caused by a proxy interpreting array dimension labels as data.

On main `28c449aa03fd5289916f0673e41c848cc126999e`, a local tibble containing a one-by-one Date matrix succeeds with an included-only Grouping specification. Expanding its rollup with a NULL Margin label instead raises expressionStackOverflowError: “evaluation nested too deeply: infinite recursion / options(expressions=)?”. Ordinary mutation using a row-sized vec_init value followed by union_all succeeds, preserves Date and the matrix shape, and returns the original row plus a row with missing components. A second independent fixture reproduced both outcomes.

The same validation boundary also recurses for POSIXct and difftime arrays, Surv matrices, and packed dimensions containing those columns or a factor matrix. Direct factor-array expansion succeeds after closed #1040; the packed factor-array case remains outside that repair. Multi-dimensional table dimensions reach a different manifestation at the same gate: their omitted prototype has all-missing counts, but the class-specific equality proxy exposes non-missing dimension labels and produces a false representability refusal. Ordinary typed-missing construction and branch combination succeed in all of these focused controls.

The focused matrix made 300 comparisons across nine type families, empty/one/three-row inputs, matrix/array shapes, direct/packed dimensions, and NULL/NA_character_ labels. All 300 ordinary controls and included-only checks succeeded. Rollup returned 126 matching results, 138 recursion failures, and 36 false table-proxy refusals. This concerns the supported unsorted row-copy boundary; ordinary grouping/sorting failures for some of these classed arrays remain upstream limitations.

The public Display labels and grouping identity contract admits local matrix/array dimensions with typed-missing labels and promises shape and missing components; its packed-dimension contract preserves inner types through dplyr/vctrs. ADR 0016 does not require restoring arbitrary attributes. This ticket needs no prefactoring ticket or implementation of the separate one-dimensional table-prototype finding.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The minimal Date-matrix rollup with NULL label and no Margin order agrees with successful ordinary typed-missing mutation/union in values, row multiplicity, shape, and column type.
- [ ] Cover empty and populated Date, POSIXct, and difftime matrices/arrays, Surv matrices, and supported packed dimensions containing these or factor arrays, with NULL and valid NA_character_ labels.
- [ ] All-missing component rows of supported multi-dimensional table dimensions pass validation even when a class proxy includes non-missing dimension labels.
- [ ] Preserve included-only behavior and the direct factor-array, integer-array, units, and integer64 controls that already succeed.
- [ ] Retain refusals for genuinely unrepresentable missing labels, non-missing structured-key labels, and the separate declared factor NA-level collision rule; NULL retains its established meaning.
- [ ] Do not add arbitrary attribute restoration, suppress independent upstream grouping/sorting conditions, or read a lazy input without authorization.

## Blocked by

None (can start immediately).

## Investigation evidence

[The dated investigation](https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/blob/68f60d32a04e89a33151891698bd979dcda03508/investigation/expand-grouping-exhaustive-hunt-2026-10-30.md) records the pinned baseline, hypotheses, independent witnesses, matrix classifications, and limits. [The classed/packed reproducer](https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/blob/68f60d32a04e89a33151891698bd979dcda03508/investigation/2026-10-30-expand-grouping-hunt/local/reproduce-classed-structured-missing.R) and [the table-proxy reproducer](https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/blob/68f60d32a04e89a33151891698bd979dcda03508/investigation/2026-10-30-expand-grouping-hunt/local/reproduce-table-structured-missing.R) have intentionally failing assertion modes on the baseline; retained logs and CSVs accompany them. A supplemental posterior rvar witness reached the same false-refusal mechanism through non-missing chain metadata in its proxy, without adding a dependency requirement. The evidence is published in PR #1077; no implementation fix is included.

title: [P2] Validate typed-missing classed array and packed dimensions safely
